mood: Editorial, Premium, B2B Enterprise, High-Contrast Warm, Awwwards-level

headings.usage: H1, H2, large manifesto numbers. Must use tracking-tight.

body.usage: Paragraphs, buttons, small labels, form inputs.

mono.usage: Data labels, code blocks, technical stats, overlines.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise overlay on backgrounds to prevent flat digital look. Use very light opacity (e.g. 1-2%).

navbar.style: Light glassmorphism: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5. Text is #1C1917. CTA button in solid #0F172A.

product_mockup_gallery.style: Photography-style presentation. Light gray radial gradient spotlight backgrounds (from-white via-stone-50 to-stone-100).
product_mockup_gallery.frames: Mockups built via HTML/Tailwind/SVG inside a rounded container (rounded-2xl, border-black/5, shadow-2xl).
product_mockup_gallery.motion: Framer Motion 3D tilt: initial { rotateX: 2, rotateY: -2, scale: 0.98 } whileHover { rotateX: 0, rotateY: 0, scale: 1 }.
product_mockup_gallery.content: Sales pipeline Kanban, Executive Dashboard, Account 360 view with AI summary panel.

hero_3d_network.colors: Nodes: #0F172A, Lines: #CBD5E1. Background MUST be transparent to show the page's #FAFAF9.
hero_3d_network.lighting: Ambient light + strong directional light to cast subtle shadows on nodes.

marquee.style: Editorial slow drift. bg-stone-100 text-stone-900. Font: Cabinet Grotesk, text-2xl or larger. Gap: 24.

manifesto_chapters.style: Massive background numerals in Cabinet Grotesk (text-8xl text-stone-200) behind the chapter text. Text is bold and high-contrast.

pricing_cards.style: Primary/Enterprise card: Inverted theme (bg-[#0F172A] text-white). Secondary cards: bg-white border border-stone-200. No generic blue buttons; use #E04006 for primary action.

forms.style: bg-white border-stone-200 rounded-lg. focus:border-[#E04006] focus:ring-[#E04006]/20. Text text-stone-900.

og_share_card.layout: Split layout. Left 60%: Massive 'Intelligent CRM' in Cabinet Grotesk (#0F172A), brand logo, subtle grid background. Right 40%: Bleeding product mockup UI with soft shadow. Accent line (#E04006) separating or highlighting.

about_office.description: Bright modern office with plants, perfect for the About Devobyte section.

team_collaboration.description: Diverse corporate team collaborating, suitable for Careers or About page.

team_collaboration_2.description: Group using laptop, good for Developers or Partners page.

data_graphs.description: Performance analytics on screen, light setting, for Industries or Resources.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all HTML/Tailwind mockup structures in the Product page are built with high precision (1px borders, subtle gradients, real-looking data) to look like actual screenshots.
Implement the 'Cabinet Grotesk' + 'Satoshi' font stack via Fontshare CDN or Google Fonts.
Transition the existing R3F network hero to light mode by updating node, edge, and lighting colors while keeping the canvas background transparent.
Follow the 'Awwwards-level' kinetic animations: use Framer Motion for scroll reveals, masks, and subtle 3D tilts on mockups.
Never use pure black or pure white; always use the tinted stone/zinc values provided in the palette.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements as per the critical rules.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially secondary text (#57534E) on #FAFAF9, meets WCAG AA contrast ratios.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all Framer Motion and R3F animations.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
